findings.title: Reflected XSS
findings.detail: Injected script marker was reflected unescaped in the response.
findings.remediation: Context-encode all user input on output; add a Content-Security-Policy.

findings.title: SQL injection (error-based)
findings.detail: A single quote triggered a database error, indicating unsanitized input in a query.
findings.remediation: Use parameterized queries / prepared statements; never concatenate input into SQL.

findings.title: Insecure cookie
findings.detail: Cookie set without httponly, secure, samesite.
findings.remediation: Set HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite on session cookies.

findings.title: Open redirect
findings.detail: Redirect destination is fully attacker-controlled.
findings.remediation: Allow-list redirect targets or use relative paths only.

findings.title: Version banner leakage

findings.remediation: Suppress or genericize the Server header.
